managed_role_policy.position: below human authority roles and above routine automation roles
managed_role_policy.note: This is an integration-managed bot role. Do not use Discord Linked Roles for the bot itself.

discovery.status_note: If Discovery Status remains yellow after commands are registered and executable, do not broaden permissions or enable Message Content solely to satisfy the badge; allow Discord metadata to reconcile and verify Discovery Settings independently.

carl_premium_state.public_fail_safe: Reset Inner Circle, resetinnercircle.com, Discord native Events, RMS CreatorHub slash commands and manual operations remain usable regardless of Carl Premium state.

tatsu_integration.control_model: Carl-bot is the Discord orchestration/policy authority; Tatsu remains the provider-owned execution surface for recognition/economy features. Carl does not receive Tatsu account credentials and no unsupported bot-to-bot administrative control is assumed.
rms_scope: provider remains available only for future manual/verified recognition if explicitly needed
no ambient XP, economy, role, notification, or entertainment automation is active
prohibited_overlap: ambient message XP when Carl Levels is the designated progression owner
licensing, publishing, rights or sync approval
duplicate announcements already owned by Carl/RMS CreatorHub App
Tatsu self-role menus while Carl owns role selection
Tatsu greeting/ban logging while Carl/Discord own logging
tatsu_integration.cost_policy: Use current/free Tatsu capabilities only. No Tatsu subscription, add-on, token purchase, paid reward inventory or upgrade without explicit Founder approval.
tatsu_integration.latest_verification: 2026-10-15: authenticated Tatsu Reset Inner Circle dashboard audited and reduced to quiet recognition-backend mode.
tatsu_integration.next_safe_action: Use Tatsu only for deliberate admin recognition/accolades when needed. Do not re-enable ambient XP/economy, self roles, leveled roles, store roles, or member-facing utility/fun/search commands while Carl remains the control authority.

now_playing.truth_policy: Never infer Discord voice/stage presence unless an approved live source explicitly confirms it. Schedule/config state may announce STARTING SOON and NEXT UP; LIVE NOW requires explicit live state or an active bounded event window.
now_playing.rights_boundary: RESET Now Playing is a community routing signal only. It does not grant publishing, licensing, distribution, payment, or rights authority.

sync.purpose: licensing-readiness and Global Sync Catalog guidance

studio.purpose: Virtual Studio and flagship production-room routing

stage.purpose: Claim Your Stage routing for cleared multidisciplinary creators

startsession.purpose: generate privacy-safe Studio reference and route authenticated persistence to CreatorHub

savesession.purpose: version and filename standard; does not claim remote DAW save

requestmix.purpose: route creator to Studio mix/master service menu

myprojects.purpose: route private project lookup to authenticated CreatorHub; no private project data stored in Discord

myaccess.purpose: route entitlement lookup to authenticated CreatorHub; no payment/access record exposed in Discord

studioservices.purpose: current Studio service menu and starting-rate routing

helpstudio.purpose: Studio command map and privacy guidance

live_production.design_goal: production apps remain independently usable and Discord remains functional if any single production component is unavailable

audio_baseline.rule: Do not route incoming Discord return audio into the same bus Discord consumes as its microphone. Shared music is opt-in; avoid duplicate capture paths.

security.carl_premium_public_access_rule: Premium automation may organize, moderate, notify, recognize and clean transient chatter; it must never become a single point of failure for base community access.
security.legacy_prefix_policy: Do not create new workflows dependent on Carl prefixes; Carl dashboard warns prefixes are retiring. Migrate leadership operation to slash-first/tag surfaces.

browser_execution_cost_policy.authentication_failure: fail closed after one confirmed login loop and switch to free/manual fallback
browser_execution_cost_policy.credential_policy: Never request passwords, MFA codes, recovery codes, or session cookies in chat.

security.tatsu_control_boundary: Carl/RMS policy may define when Tatsu is used, but Tatsu configuration remains provider-owned and requires its own authenticated dashboard. Never share or automate Discord/Tatsu credentials between bots.

resilience.rms_creatorhub_app_failure: Carl-bot, Discord native Events, and manual RMS operations remain usable
resilience.carl_bot_failure: Discord Events, RMS CreatorHub App, Tatsu recognition (if independently available), and manual RMS operations remain usable; Tatsu must not inherit moderation or access-control authority.
resilience.zapier_failure: send one private automation-alerts notice and use manual event fallback
resilience.tatsu_failure: No customer-critical flow depends on Tatsu. Carl, Discord native controls, RMS CreatorHub App, and manual recognition remain available.
resilience.production_app_failure: continue Discord communication and switch to the approved manual media fallback
resilience.browser_connector_failure: Use service-native APIs/connectors first; then free local headed browser/manual screenshot execution. Do not spend on metered browser automation without explicit Founder approval.

assistance.host_readiness: explicit current-route checklist and listener attestation; not device telemetry
assistance.human_takeover: explicit staff controls; no unobserved-message inference
assistance.quiet_recognition: policy_prepared; exact Glow Exchange application/dashboard not changed
